'''Żebbuġ Rangers Football Club''' is a semi-professional [[association football|football]] club from the town of [[Żebbuġ, Malta|Żebbuġ]] in [[Malta]]. The club currently competes in the [[Maltese Challenge League]]. In the [[2021–22 Maltese Challenge League|2022]] they won the Maltese Challenge League after a win against [[Pembroke Athleta]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Aquilina |first1=Kurt |title=Żebbuġ Rangers crowned champions after penalty shoot-out win over Pembroke |url=https://sport.timesofmalta.com/2022/04/23/zebbug-rangers-crowned-champions-after-penalty-shoot-out-win-over-pembroke/#:~:text=%C5%BBebbu%C4%A1%20Rangers%20were%20crowned%20champions,all%20the%20way%20since%202019. |access-date=8 July 2024 |work=Times of Malta |date=23 April 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=New general secretary for FMA |url=https://www.maltafootball.com/2021/08/27/new-general-secretary-for-fma/ |website=Malta Football |access-date=8 July 2024 |date=27 August 2021|quote=Jurgen D’Amato who was appointed as Team Manager at Zebbug FC.}}</ref>"}}
